fields.Name: T142 - Integrations Schedules
fields.Description: Verifies the Schedules section of the Integrations app renders the schedules view without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Integrations app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo/Home icon (NOT the Ctrl+K search box). Open the Schedules section (/app/integrations/Schedules) from the app's left navigation. Confirm the schedules view renders: either schedule rows/cards are visible, or a clean empty-state placeholder is shown if none are configured. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for content rather than navigating away. Success is the Integrations Schedules view rendering with no crash.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Integrations app is active and the Schedules section is displayed
The schedules view shows schedule rows/cards, or a clean empty-state placeholder
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
